titre: Promote to a queen, or a knight? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Queen, or knight? 👇 Only 1.d8=N+! wins: it checks the king and hits the queen. 1.d8=Q Qb4+ is just a perpetual check (Stockfish 16, composed position). One new puzzle every day.
